metadata.title: PILOT GROUND-TRUTH RECOVERY TEST: JARDIM DAS NAÇÕES
rules_applied: Do not use QQQ/LLL sequential numbering to place parcels.
Do not assume odd/even parity alone confers EXACT_STREET_FACE.
Separate pre-existing knowledge from new recovery (incremental recovery only counted if stronger than pre-phase baseline).
Distinguish rediscovered baseline sources from newly discovered sources.

pilot_records.rediscovered_baseline_source: Diário Oficial Eletrônico de Taubaté - Edição 906 (URL: https://plenussistemas.dioenet.com.br/diario/publicacoes/33470)
pilot_records.post_phase_corner_or_frontage: Frontage to Rua Argentina within Quadra Q (No corner confrontation specified)
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Although Lote 13 and Quadra Q are confirmed from gazette 906, no house number or corner description is present to identify the exact side of Rua Argentina without using cadastral parity conventions. Preserved as STREET_ONLY.

pilot_records.rediscovered_baseline_source: Diário Oficial Eletrônico de Taubaté - Edição 977 (URL: https://plenussistemas.dioenet.com.br/diario/publicacoes/35835)
pilot_records.new_source_found: Matrícula nº 86.760 CRI Taubaté (cited in Gazette 977 notice)
pilot_records.post_phase_corner_or_frontage: Rua França odd door number 261; Quadra O interior lot
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Gazette 977 establishes explicit binding to Rua França nº 261, Quadra O, Lote 14. In physical road block PRB-0419/PRB-0746, door number 261 anchors to the designated street segment. Under Addendum 1 of Phase 2.3X1, door number alone without corner certidão provides PROBABLE_STREET_FACE, upgrading from pre-phase STREET_ONLY.
Municipal Habite-se record binds BC 3.1.009.006.001 to Rua França nº 261 (residential building sharing the physical site of 3.1.009.004). Upgraded from STREET_ONLY to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE.

pilot_records.new_source_found: Processo de Execução Cível nº 1004821-44.2021.8.26.0625 (1ª Vara Cível de Taubaté)
pilot_records.post_phase_corner_or_frontage: Corner lot of Quadra A at intersection of Rua França with perpendicular street
pilot_records.post_phase_reasoning: Judicial auction edital explicitly identifies BC 3.1.014.001.001 as Lote 01 da Quadra A on Rua França. While a head lot description provides strong frontage localization, full corner confrontation metes-and-bounds were not retrieved to establish EXACT_STREET_FACE. Upgraded to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE.

Municipal tax notification binds BC 3.3.019.005.001 to Rua Síria nº 560. High-number location indicates outer street segment bordering Jardim Continental II. Upgraded from STREET_ONLY to PROBABLE_STREET_FACE.
